description: JmapBackend's query_objects requires O::Filter and O::Comparator associated types implementing serde::Deserialize. Define these typed structs for Email and Mailbox objects covering the RFC 8621 filter/sort fields stoa currently handles via raw Value. Belongs to epic stoa-z8tz8.
title: Define EmailFilter, EmailComparator, MailboxFilter, MailboxComparator types
